parameters.name: warehouses
parameters.description: Set of warehouses indexed by $w$, with $W=\{0,1\}$ corresponding to warehouses $A$ and $B$

parameters.name: raw_material_types
parameters.description: Set of raw material types indexed by $r$

parameters.name: demand
parameters.description: Minimum required daily quantity of each raw material type $r$

parameters.name: transport_yield_per_truck
parameters.description: Quantity of material $r$ delivered by one truck from warehouse $w$

parameters.name: truck_cost
parameters.description: Freight cost per truck dispatched from each warehouse $w$

parameters.name: planning_horizon
parameters.description: Single-day planning horizon index set with $T=\{0\}$

variables.name: trucks_dispatched
variables.description: Number of trucks dispatched daily from each warehouse $w$

variables.name: total_freight_cost
variables.description: Total daily freight cost incurred by the dispatch plan

constraints.name: nonnegative_integer_truck_dispatch
constraints.description: The number of trucks dispatched from each warehouse must be a nonnegative integer.

constraints.name: material_demand_satisfaction
constraints.description: For each raw material type r, the total quantity delivered by trucks from all warehouses must meet or exceed the minimum daily demand.
constraints.formula: \sum_{w\in W} q_{w,r} x_w \ge d_r \quad \forall r\in R

constraints.name: fixed_mix_per_truck
constraints.description: Each dispatched truck from warehouse w delivers a fixed mix of raw materials q_{w,r}; this is captured directly in the demand satisfaction constraints and requires no separate restriction beyond the delivery coefficients.
constraints.formula: \sum_{w\in W} q_{w,r} x_w \text{ is the delivered amount of material } r

constraints.name: total_freight_cost_definition
constraints.description: Define total freight cost as the sum of per-truck freight costs over all dispatched trucks.

constraints.name: single_day_no_carryover_or_backlog
constraints.description: Single-day planning is modeled implicitly by using only daily dispatch variables, so no intertemporal flow variables are needed; there is no carryover or backlog state in the model.
constraints.formula: \text{Single-day planning model with no inventory carryover or backlog}

objectives.name: minimize_total_freight_cost
objectives.description: Minimize the total daily freight cost of dispatching trucks from the warehouses while satisfying all raw material demand requirements.

final_objective.description: Minimize the total daily freight cost of dispatching trucks from the two warehouses while meeting or exceeding all raw material demands.
